core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hatam corresponds to the Arabic form حاتم (Arabic root خ ت م (kh-t-m); حَاتِم (Ḥātim)). Its core sense is seal, concluder, finisher. Hatam is a variant transliteration of Arabic حَاتِم (Ḥātim) 'seal, concluder, finisher', from the root خ ت م (kh-t-m). It is a well-documented Arabic personal name, borne by Hatim al-Ta'i, famed for his generosity. The source gloss 'Gifted, Generous' reflects the cultural association rather than the lexical sense. Same name as hatem and hatim.
